items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: But my mother was a great dancer.

ctx.x: Dancing back and forth. I think it's gonna come back some.

They dance flat-footed. They dance in their bare feet. I think something should be done to educate the public and get them interested in jazz ballroom dancing. I don't expect to do any more of it this late and long, but I think it was beautiful when it lasted. I went to many jazz dancing after I was a widow at 26. But my mother was a great dancer. She used to tell me when she was a girl that she used to run out and dance. And my sister out in Gentilly was another one, and his mother, she danced on the stage,…
